name: git-things
description: A Git pane like VS Code's Source Control: stage, commit (with a generated message), branches, sync, history, stash and compare, with inline diffs

openWith.title: Open files with
openWith.description: The command that opens a file from the pane, the file's path added last (e.g. "code -g", "idea"). Empty opens it in the system's default app.

generateModel.title: Commit message model
generateModel.description: The model ✨ Generate asks for a commit message: an alias (haiku, sonnet) or a full model id.
